title: India fastest-growing steel market, demand to grow 7.9% in 2026: worldsteel
description:
India remains the world's fastest-growing major steel market, with demand projected to expand by 7.9 per cent to 172.4 million tonnes in 2026, the World Steel Association (worldsteel) said on Monday.
The country's demand is expected to rise by 8 per cent in 2027 to 186.2 million tonnes (MT), the industry body said in its 'Short Range Outlook October 2026'.
worldsteel said it forecasts global steel demand will remain essentially unchanged at 1,722 MT in 2026 before returning to 1.7 per cent growth in 2027 to reach 1,752 MT.
However, steel demand in China - the world's largest steel-producing nation - is likely to drop by 2 per cent in 2026. In 2027, contraction in China is also expected to narrow to 1 per cent, the Belgium-based industry body said.
India remains the world's fastest-growing major steel market, with demand estimated to expand by 7.9 per cent in 2026 to 172.4 MT and by 8 per cent in 2027 to 186.2 per cent.
